briefdescription.para: This file provides a collection of visitors which walk the (instruction) uses of a pointer.

detaileddescription.para: These visitors all provide the same essential behavior as an InstVisitor with similar template-based flexibility and implementation strategies.
These can be used, for example, to quickly analyze the uses of an alloca, global variable, or function argument.
